description: Return what is currently true for an agent_id and key. IMPORTANT: if the key is contested (two or more live values with neither superseding the other), this returns ALL competing values and flags the conflict rather than silently choosing one — surfacing conflicts is the point. Returns nothing (404, credit refunded) if the key was never set or has been retired. A contested read is charged. Costs 1 credit.
name: get_assertion
